# Support Resources for Harmonify

We want every Harmonify user—self-hosted or on the upcoming Harmonify Cloud—to have a clear path to help. Start with the channel that best fits your request:

## 🐞 Bugs & Regressions
- Search existing [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Collins-Omariba/harmonify/issues) to avoid duplicates.
- If you file a new issue, include:
  - The Harmonify version (git commit hash or release tag)
  - Steps to reproduce
  - Expected vs. actual behavior
  - Environment details (self-hosted, Docker, Harmonify Cloud, browser)

## 💡 Feature Ideas & Roadmap Discussions
- Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Collins-Omariba/harmonify/issues) - (just issues now will be an actual discussion after moving to an org) - for open-ended ideas.
- Tag requests that relate to Harmonify Cloud so we can assess hosted vs. self-hosted impact.

## 🔐 Security Vulnerabilities
- Please report security issues privately to (will add email here).
- Avoid filing public issues until we coordinate a fix and disclosure window.

## ☁️ Harmonify Cloud Customers (Upcoming)
- Managed sync, encrypted backups, and premium modules will be supported once the service launches.
- Cloud customers also receive an invite to a private status page and incident updates.

## 🤝 Community Support
- Join the community chat (coming soon!) for casual help and collaboration.
- Keep interactions respectful and aligned with our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## 📚 Documentation Gaps
- Found something unclear in the docs? Open an issue or submit a pull request to improve it!

Thank you for helping us make Harmonify a friendly, reliable platform for everyone.
